title: Superiore — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Superiore.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "La Cucina Italiana." Premium tier. Superiore makes Italian luxury ranges with distinctive design and brass accents. Distributed by Tasco in Canada. Handcrafted in Italy with premium materials.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Italian luxury kitchen builds through Tasco dealers. Design-forward range buyers.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Superiore:

• Handcrafted Italian luxury ranges

• Brass accents and premium materials

• Tasco distribution in Canada

• Distinctive Italian design

• Competes with Bertazzoni and ILVE
